title: Points Earned on a Snowsports School Booking Recorded Well Ahead of Its First Session
content:
A household that commits early earns the early booking reduction on its Snowsports School booking: a reduction in percentage points on the block price of the product booked. It is counted in calendar days between the day the booking was recorded and the date the first session is due to run, the day of recording counting as day zero.

Where a booking was recorded fourteen or more days ahead of its first session and the product is sold up to a hundred and twenty days ahead or further, the early booking points are earned, and they stand at 8 points. Where a booking was recorded fourteen or more days ahead of its first session and the product is sold up to fewer than a hundred and twenty days ahead, the ahead booking points are earned, and they stand at 4 points. Where a booking was recorded fewer than fourteen days ahead of its first session, no advance points are earned, the reduction standing at 0 points.

## How far ahead each product is sold

| Product | Sold up to (calendar days ahead) |
| --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 120 |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 120 |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 120 |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 180 |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 120 |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 180 |
| Elite Performance Camp | 270 |

## The bands as a truth table

| Days between recording and the first session | Product sold up to 120 days ahead or further | Points earned |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 14 or more | yes | 8 |
| 14 or more | no | 4 |
| exactly 14 | yes | 8 |
| 13 | either | 0 |
| none, the booking recorded on the session day | either | 0 |

## Both sides of the day threshold

A booking recorded on the first of a month whose first session is due on the fifteenth stands 14 calendar days ahead, counting the first as day zero, and so earns points on the day count. The same booking whose first session is due on the fourteenth stands 13 days ahead and earns none.
